title: OrbitalElements
description: Persisted elliptic Keplerian elements, not recomputed on read. Distances are km, angles degrees, period seconds, eccentricity dimensionless. epoch is the UTC element reference epoch, independent of spatial.epochMs. The seeder solves Kepler's equation, forms perifocal (xp, yp)=(a(cos(E)-e), a*sqrt(1-e^2)*sin(E)), then applies the active right-handed rotation Rz(longitudeOfAscendingNodeDeg) Rx(inclinationDeg) Rz(argumentOfPeriapsisDeg); +X cross +Y = +Z. Thus a circular zero-inclination orbit lies in XY; at zero argument/node, +X at mean anomaly 0 advances to +Y at 90 degrees, and positive inclination tips +Y toward +Z. The formula defines implementation math, not an external inertial alignment. Source elements do not all declare or normalize a common physical reference plane. anchorBodyId identifies a non-star orbital origin; absent/null means the stellar/system origin. Signed nonzero periods preserve curated retrograde source conventions: propagation uses absolute period duration; inclination defines orientation, so the sign is not applied twice.

orbitalPeriodSec.description: Signed catalog period in seconds; absolute duration must be at least one second.
